anya: quick update — brought up a new candidate embeddings model (v2-small-quant) on wiki holdout. did a quick recall@10 vs baseline and saw ~3.2% drop, recall@1 about 1.1% down. curious if this is quantization artefact or embed-space rotation. :thinking:

matt: can you paste the eval command + config? which quant backend?

anya: running with ONNX int8 per-channel quant (calib set 5k). eval command: `python eval/recall_holdout.py --model v2-small-quant --dataset wiki-holdout --k 10 --seed 42 --batch 256 --norm l2`

anya: output snippet:
```
Baseline v2-small (float): recall@1=0.824, recall@5=0.912, recall@10=0.942
v2-small-quant (onnx int8 pc): recall@1=0.815, recall@5=0.898, recall@10=0.910
delta recall@10 = -0.032
silhouette avg: baseline=0.41, quant=0.39
cluster purity@k=5: baseline=0.78, quant=0.74
```

sarah: hmm 3.2% at @10 is meaningful. did you normalize post-quantization? sometimes int8 scaling changes norm distribution. also which similarity metric? cosine?

anya: yes cosine. I L2-normalize after inference. checked embedding norms: mean norm baseline=1.001, quant=0.987, std slightly higher for quant. not massive but could shift top-k ordering.

matt: can you run a small ablation: keep fp16 weights but simulate int8 activation quant (dynamic) vs per-channel? that'll tell if weight quant is main culprit. also run recall@1/5/10 with no norm to see raw dot-product effect.

anya: queued two jobs: `quant_ablation/dyn_act_only` and `quant_ablation/fp16_weights_int8_act` (started). ETA ~12m.

embed-bot: Auto-Eval: job 1946123456-01 finished. recall@10 delta = -0.031. Regression flagged (threshold 2%). See /eval/1946123456-01/logs

anya: dyn-act-only run shows recall@10 delta -0.008 (much better). so activation quant hurt most.

anya: quick cluster viz (UMAP) — small rotation, some border points jump clusters. attaching ASCII summary:
```
clusters changed: 4.5% of points moved cluster label
avg inter-cluster distance delta: -0.02
```

matt: ok that points to calibration/scaling on activations. try per-tensor vs per-channel for activations and also check calib set representativeness. your 5k calib might be skewed (wiki slices). use stratified sample across domains.

anya: good call. will run with stratified 20k calib (wiki + news + qna mix). also will try adding embedding rescaling layer (learned scale) as a quick recovery hack.

sarah: also add eval for recall@k broken out by query length buckets (short/medium/long) — quant can hurt long-context serp queries differently.

anya: added buckets, and larger calib. re-run scheduled. will report back in this thread. :thumbsup:

matt: thanks — if stratified calib recovers >1.5% of the drop we can consider shipping with per-channel act quant + stratified calib. otherwise fallback to hybrid fp16-activations.

anya: noted. follow-ups: 1) re-run ablations (in flight) 2) stratified calib 20k 3) embedding rescale trial 4) add bucketed recall. will post numbers.

embed-bot: Reminder: keep eval artifacts under /artifacts/embeds/1946123456 to ensure reproducibility.

anya: saved logs and seeds there. ping me for access. :eyes:
